title: Stoke Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: Stoke Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 7, 2026, announcing the appointment of Dr. G. Clare Kahn to its Board of Directors as a Class I director, effective April 3, 2026. Dr. Kahn was also appointed to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee and as chairperson of the Research and Development Committee.
key_points: Dr. G. Clare Kahn appointed as Class I director effective April 3, 2026
Board size increased to ten directors to accommodate the appointment
Dr. Kahn qualifies as an independent director under Nasdaq listing standards
Annual cash retainer of $45,000 for board service
Initial stock option grant of 30,782 shares with approximately $724,000 target grant date fair value, vesting quarterly over three years
Dr. Kahn also chairs the Research and Development Committee
